bio.text: Thomas Smith, a retired General Motors engineer, won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for Michigan's 8th Congressional District with just over 50% of the vote.
He had suspended his campaign in mid-July and endorsed another candidate, but his name remained on the ballot because ballots had already been printed.
He is a small business owner of a salsa company and faces Democratic Rep. Kristen McDonald Rivet in November.

sources.title: Republican Congressional candidate wins 8th district primary even though he dropped out
